content.v: Moon工作室CEO、《奥日》系列主创托马斯·马勒（Thomas Mahler）认为，未来几年单靠AI做出完整、成熟的游戏仍不现实。他同时表示，AI工具在合适的开发者手中可以发挥作用。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790633568_183997_jpg_r.jpg
马勒在社交平台发文称，他看到不少人相信AI会在未来几年内制作出完整且经过充分打磨的游戏，但他认为这种情况不太可能很快发生。
生成式AI模型已经能够产出看起来颇有水准的玩法演示。不过，马勒认为，大多数展示AI游戏制作能力的演示效果并不好；如果将这类内容作为游戏推出，也很难在市场上立足。
在马勒看来，做出一款人们愿意接触的游戏，本身就是一种创作。他认为，当前许多AI生成内容没有解决这一点。至于AI工具的用途，他强调仍需要有能力的开发者引导它们。
Thomas Mahler推文：
我完全不是AI的仇恨者，但是……我在这里看到很多帖子，都是那些坚信AI将在未来几年内构建出完整、精致的游戏的人。
我觉得那不太可能。我一直在大量摆弄所有前沿模型，我们显然还远未达到那个水平。
有趣的是，我们甚至在写作上都还没达到那个目标。为什么?它不就是文字吗?鉴于这些AI模型已经训练了现存的每一本书，让它们能像优秀作家那样写出一个短篇故事，应该不是不可能的，对吧?
但目前，它绝对是。
尽管如此，即使是最好的顶级模型，也无法用恰当的散文体写出一页，带着你从海明威、莎士比亚等人那里看到的那种创作意图。
那里仍然缺少着什么。有才华的人类即使没有超级智能也能做到，但即使是绝对顶尖的AI模型也根本做不到。 而每一种更复杂的艺术形式——比如游戏——将多种艺术形式融合为一体的，只会让这个问题更加凸显。
我看到网上很多人自豪地发帖说“AI一击就搞定这个游戏了！”，但那些东西仍然是糟糕透顶的，没人会真的考虑花钱买。即使是非一击完成的，99%那些……嗯，不怎么样。
现在，别误会我的意思，我确实认为在真正创意人士手中，这些工具是福音，会让人们能完成比以前多得多的东西。
但它仍然非常需要掌握在真正懂得行的人手中。
大众仍然会想要玩那些某些创意人士投入数千小时的疯狂成就，在那里你能看出每一个组件都倾注了大量的爱和努力——就像他们一直以来那样。
我觉得，很多对LLM创建出他们自己的个人魔兽世界感到兴奋的人——可能只达到了15%的程度——然后会发现，第二部分，真正创建一个让人们兴奋并愿意花钱的产品，基本上本身就是一种艺术形式。

content.v: 育碧已取消的《U计划》近日流出一张玩法截图，展示了这款PvE游戏的画面。项目原本围绕多支四人队伍与敌人战斗展开。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790633689_973766_jpg_r.jpg
截图来自X用户Kran。他发布时还问道：既然游戏已经取消，公开图片是否仍会违反自己签署的保密协议。
按照项目的玩法设计，十支队伍各由四名玩家组成。队伍在地图的不同区域推进，以PvE方式迎战难度逐步提高的敌人。参与试玩的人认为游戏有趣，但育碧一直难以解决反复游玩的吸引力问题。
《U计划》此前使用过“探路者”这一开发代号。项目在2024年末经历大幅调整，当时育碧仍认为PvE游戏有成功空间。2025年，游戏的开场动画曾在网上流出，育碧随后依据DMCA要求移除了该影片。
项目早期版本曾以《幽灵行动：荒野》的地图为基础搭建游戏地图，试图节省开发时间和成本。后期版本的敌人则大量借鉴了《地平线》系列中的机械生物，希望让玩家对游戏产生更多兴趣。
《U计划》在开发约七年后，于2026年初育碧重组期间被取消。玩家在地图中如何行进，是项目面临的问题之一。育碧内部人士还表示，项目长期缺乏整体方向与明确构想，开发过程中遇到过多种问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《异形：火力精英2》发售仅一个多月，开发商Cold Iron Studios就发生裁员。母公司Enad Global 7于上周晚些时候公布消息，并表示游戏的后续开发与支持将继续。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790633650_812981_jpg_r.jpg
外媒InsiderGaming称，本轮裁员至少涉及19人。公开记录显示，Cold Iron Studios在裁员前约有50至70名员工。
Enad Global 7表示，此次缩减人员符合原定计划，目的是降低工作室运营成本，使其今后能够持续运营。公司称，Cold Iron Studios仍将专注于《异形：火力精英2》的开发和支持。
截至9月28日，2026年游戏行业已有超过1.1万人因裁员失去工作，涉及144家公司，至少32家工作室关闭。对于《异形：火力精英2》，Enad Global 7表示，游戏的Switch2版目前计划于2027年初推出。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: Double Fine 被 Xbox 抛弃后的第一款游戏将在两周内推出
items.summary: I don't know what I expected, but Thank You Bus Driver sure isn't it. It does look like fun, though.

content.v: It's been less than three months since Xbox kicked Double Fine Productions to the curb as part of the great "streamlining" that Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella is so excited to see . And just two weeks from today, the studio will release the first game of its post-Xbox existence: It's not what I expected, but it is most definitely a Double Fine game.
Thank You Bus Driver is a driving sim, but not of the sort you'd find in the Bus Simulator series. There are three—and only three—priorities:

Over on Bluesky, Double Fine described Thank You Bus Driver as "Crazy Taxi meets Papers, Please!" which sounds like exactly the sort of game the studio would make—this is, after all, the studio that gave us a multiplayer brawling game about pottery .

Clock in, drive the bus, and get passengers to their stops...but SLAP anyone breaking the rules (or throw 'em out the back if they don't behave)! It's Crazy Taxi meets Papers, Please! Launching October 14~Wishlist THANK YOU BUS DRIVER:doublefine.com/games/thank-you-bus-driver#buynow

Thank You Bus Driver doesn't look like a 'big' game, even by Double Fine standards (which I say with the utmost respect), and you may notice that it's being published by something called Double Fine Action Labs. In an interview with GamesBeat earlier this month, Double Fine CEO Tim Schafer said it's a label the studio will use for "experiments," such as the games that come out of the studio's Amnesia Fortnight game jams.

"They're complete games. They're not incomplete. But they're rough and scrappy and small. They're meant to be cheap and played for shorter amounts of time," Schafer said. Using the separate label, he continued, sets expectations at an appropriate level: "This is not Psychonauts 3. This is an experimental thing. We had a lot of fun with it, and we thought it was fun enough to share with people."

To be clear, Thank You Bus Driver is not part of the ongoing Amnesia Fortnite 2026, which will wrap up its very successful Kickstarter (and name a final winner) later this week. And it will be out very soon—on October 14, to be exact. You can wishlist it now on Steam , GOG , and Itch.io .

content.v: 近日《 魔界战记 》创作者新川宗平表示，生成式AI可以帮助提高游戏开发效率，但他无意让它替自己编写故事。对他来说，创作故事和角色本身就是制作游戏的动力。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790630959_584283_jpg_r.jpg
新川宗平曾创作初代《魔界战记》。在接受电击Online采访时，他被问及AI是威胁还是助力。他认为，能提高生产效率的环节可以使用这类工具，但必须避开侵犯版权等违法行为；他也没有把AI视为威胁。
谈到让AI完成整部作品，新川宗平表示，他不认为自己有生之年会看到完全不需人类参与就能完成作品的技术。他也不想只提供情节，再让工具写出成品：这种方式或许适合大量产出，却不符合他的创作目标。
因此，他目前写作时不使用AI。如果要用，也只会让它协助想角色名、作品名或查找资料。他不打算从工具列出的所谓畅销故事中挑选题材，而是希望自己决定写什么，并亲手组织文字。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790630960_948660_jpg_r.jpg
对于年轻开发者该培养什么能力，新川宗平强调，要能构思打动人的游戏体验，也要能判断AI给出的方案哪一个适合游戏。他认为，即使借助工具实现想法，开发者仍需把握作品的核心。他的新作《恶魔之夜狂热》定于10月22日发售。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 新游戏即将为 Steam 的整理热潮注入鲜血
items.summary: Steam has seen an avalanche of cheap and cheerful tidying-up games lately, from libraries to magic shops to to

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/28/somethingwronglibrary-keyart-1790630303686.jpg
Steam has seen an avalanche of cheap and cheerful tidying-up games lately, from libraries to magic shops to toy stores, but the genre is about to get weird.

New game Something is Wrong With the Library is still about organizing books, but this time around, you're doing it while dealing with "psychic manifestations" made of flesh. Makes sense, considering the walls of the building are full of the corpses of homeless people. You can wishlist it now on Steam , ready for its release later this fall.

Unlike most of the clearing clutter genre, Something is Wrong With the Library stands out because it appears to have a (deeply messed up) story to go with all the chores. You play as the library's former administrator, Phillip Shed, who has one night to organize the books and deal with the gory consequences of the bodies in the walls. According to the Steam listing, players can also expect to find something called The Drowning Room, which doesn't sound ominous at all.

Meaty monstrosities aside, you can expect brutal bibliophile realism, thanks to the developer's previous career. “If you've ever been in a library at night, you'll know that it feels unexpectedly warm and full of possibility–until you hear a single sound you don't recognize and realize you're surrounded by towering shadows.” says studio head Xalavier Nelson Jr.
“As a former librarian, I truly hope that, despite the objectively messed-up things they're going to witness, everyone who plays the game falls in love with their local library a little more.”
It's notable that Nelson was the lead developer on another deeply weird Steam gem, CLICKOLDING , where you have to sit in a room across from a sinister stranger and click a button 10,000 times.

content.v: 近日《流放之路》设计师克里斯·威尔逊表示，他非常希望《暗黑破坏神5》成为一款好游戏。他认为如果新作取得成功，将吸引更多玩家接触动作角色扮演游戏；目前他对这款游戏抱有谨慎的期待。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790630415_781068_jpg_r.jpg
威尔逊说，《暗黑破坏神》系列促使他走上制作《流放之路》的道路。他少年时沉迷《暗黑破坏神2》，在该作发售六年后、续作仍无消息时，他与朋友一起创作《流放之路》，希望有新的动作角色扮演游戏可玩。不过，他表示自己对系列近几部作品逐渐失去了兴趣：《暗黑破坏神3》推出后没能吸引他，《暗黑破坏神4》公布时展示的一些设计也未能引起他的期待。
这次公布的《暗黑破坏神5》让威尔逊看到了一丝希望。他特别提到新作标志采用燃烧的黑色文字，令他想起系列前两作的标志。但他仍提醒自己不要过早兴奋，并认为暴雪公开谈及曾考虑将新作做成《暗黑破坏神4》资料片，可能影响玩家对它作为独立新作的信心。
尽管如此，威尔逊仍希望《暗黑破坏神5》取得成功。他认为ARPG玩家渴望更多内容，如果这款游戏足够好，吸引大量新玩家进入这一类型，他们之后也可能尝试其他作品。用他的话说，“水涨船高”。

items.summary: Tied to in-game time, not real time. If you activated a double XP token, you'd assume it would only be active

others.title: 《使命召唤：现代战争 4》终于让双倍 XP 代币仅在比赛期间激活

content.v: Tied to in-game time, not real time.
If you activated a double XP token, you'd assume it would only be active when you can actually earn XP, right?

That has not been the case in the Call of Duty series for all of time, as the franchise allows the token's XP timer to keep on counting down to zero even when you're not in matches, like in a lobby. Essentially, you'll activate a double XP token for 30 minutes, and maybe a third of that time will be spent simply waiting for the game to transition from one match to the next.

items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever players find black market NPC who sells a 15-day movement speed buff and other rare items that nobody can afford yet
items.summary: Blizzard is also using it to get ahead of price inflation.

content.v: Even though World of Warcraft: Forever is only in beta right now, players are able to explore a good amount of Azeroth to see what secrets Blizzard has tucked away for the full release.

Several secrets have been found, like a bunch of hidden books that reward powerful leveling items, but some of them have hints for what to expect when it launches in November. There are plenty of items that don't have a clear use yet that might become extremely valuable as time goes on.

A new NPC was recently found in the new Riverglades zone who sells a bunch of expensive crafting items. Theoretically, you should be able to get these items by playing the game normally, but many WoW: Forever players suspect he exists to prevent the auction house prices from skyrocketing due to their rarity.

Mister Graphed, the black market goblin merchant , sells items for 20+ gold—a hefty chunk of change in the Classic-era of WoW—that should prevent anyone from feeling obligated to buy them for more than that from other players. I'm sure it'll still happen because people love to sell items you can buy from vendors at a premium for the convenience of not having to travel around, but it will at least keep the prices from getting too ridiculous.

Notably, though, the vendor also sells new crafting materials called Fel Crystal and Stranglevine. Blizzard has done a big overhaul of professions in WoW: Forever, making them considerably more useful while you're leveling up. I was able to craft a nice set of gear before I was anywhere close to the beta's level cap of 20. These new items suggest there will be some really rare items to craft that never existed in previous versions of the MMO.

One item is available that isn't a crafting item at all: It's called the Gift of Galloping and it's a whopping 150 gold. This item says it gives you a 10% boost to your mounted movement speed for 15 days. Classic WoW never had anything like it, but I guess if you're rich you can pay a pricey subscription fee to go a little faster if you want.

It seems Blizzard is doing its best to prepare for WoW: Forever being a game that won't transition into new expansions. The level cap will permanently stay at 60, so there will have to be reasons for players to keep playing their characters or start new ones. It also means the economy will need things like that NPC in place so that the prices don't get out of control as players presumably get more powerful and the mysteries of the game get solved.

content.v: Sucker Punch公布了《羊蹄山之魂》与《最后生还者》联动的循声者主题护甲。护甲将随10月1日推出的《羊蹄山之魂》完整版加入游戏，玩家需要游玩新版“头号通缉”模式才能解锁。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790629014_944476_jpg_r.jpg
《羊蹄山之魂》原版于去年推出。此次完整版将增加新剧情DLC、Roguelike模式和外观内容；循声者护甲是Sucker Punch在此前公布的内容之外，进一步公开的联动外观。
这套护甲以《最后生还者》中的循声者为原型，面具采用其变异头部的造型，肩部和背部也带有类似菌类的形态。Sucker Punch此前曾在《对马岛之魂》中加入以《战神》和《地平线》为主题的外观。
Sucker Punch确认，循声者护甲只能通过完整版独有的“头号通缉”模式解锁。仅持有《羊蹄山之魂》原版的玩家，需要升级至完整版才能取得这套护甲。具体解锁条件尚未公布。
解锁后，护甲的使用范围不限于“头号通缉”模式。玩家也可以在《羊蹄山之魂》的原版游戏内容及多人合作模式中穿戴。

items.title: 互联网正在仪式性地谋杀 Discord 的卡通吉祥物
items.summary: Is that good?

content.v: Last week, Discord finally pulled the trigger on the global rollout of its age estimation systems, which require users to provide age verification through an ID scan or selfie if the company's estimation model can't confidently surmise that you're older than 18. While Discord estimated that 90% of users wouldn't need to prove their age, accompanying bugginess drove the company to address the emerging issues by posting on X with the air of being just a little guy.

Nobody liked that. Discord's ill-advised smol bean-posting has become a flashpoint for the internet's collective frustration over being forced to swallow what's widely perceived— with good reason —as the prelude to an inevitable exposure of private information. To vent that simmering resentment, X users have turned to creative outlets. By which I mean they've been drawing Wumpus, Discord's mascot, meeting a variety of grisly ends.
when you launch an extremely popular age assurance update that everyone on Discord was really looking forward to and it has bugs https://t.co/I9dVu9ZhET pic.twitter.com/BLAz9fWTSn September 24, 2026

While I don't recommend you browse the full selection of ritualized Wumpus-slayings—some of them are pretty gnarly—here's a survey of how the internet is processing its feelings about age verification.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nX6Xrr8bE7PdiC8evt5bQe.jpg
Wumpus gets the Daguza Mackle treatment , by @Cassius_comm .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tAdY4GiZq7Exx8VQDthwHb.jpg
Saturn Devours His Chat Application, by @Ph4nt0m3nby .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/J8rGCSzd5xvE7jRswvxzpc.jpg
Wumpus encounters the cruelties of fluid dynamics, by @Lizardbrainiak .
And, in emulation of that moment from the 2014 Godzilla that made me say "Jesus, Godzilla, who taught you that," there's this work from X user @Atlanticaph0tic :
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cfjqEmhCffjzLTLLKMbY3B-1920-80.jpg

There are more, of course: There are illustrations of Wumpus being drawn and quartered in historically brutal fashion, and .gifs of Wumpus being squished in a space pod by a legendary super saiyan before being exploded—both of which have been amassed a combined 400,000 likes and 8 million views.
I'm not an expert, but when the masses are cheering for your company mascot's cruel unmaking, I suspect there's been a PR misstep somewhere along the way.

content.v: 近日外媒wccftech公布《巫师3：重制版》新实机演示，展示4K+路径追踪画面。可以看到场景光照明显改善，但战斗手感和角色模型仍显陈旧。一起来看看视频吧！
实机演示：
重制版于今日(9月29日)推出，版本号为5.00。游戏曾在2022年12月获得次世代更新，加入光线追踪和更高分辨率的贴图；这次更新则安排在计划于2027年推出的新资料片《往昔之歌》之前。现有的《石之心》和《血与酒》资料片也已包含在游戏本体中。
CDPR公布的改动包括环境、角色和怪物贴图升级，植被、光照与渲染调整。PC版新增路径追踪，并支持NVIDIA DLSS 4.5光线重建；PS5 Pro版可借助PSSR在开启光线追踪时达到60帧。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790628532_712108_jpg_r.jpg
从PC版试玩来看，路径追踪改善了室内外的光照，室内尤其明显。植被和法印特效也有提升，其中伊格尼法印的变化较突出。相比之下，角色模型只得到小幅改善，近距离观察时仍显旧，水面效果也没有跟上其他画面改动。
试玩者使用GeForce RTX 5090和Ryzen 7 9800X3D，在4K分辨率、最高画质、DLSS质量模式及动态多帧生成设置下，于诺维格瑞城内进行自定路线测试，测得平均帧率为161.7帧。这组数据来自该配置和测试路线，不能代表其他设备的表现。
玩法方面，重制版重做了技能树，并加入新动作、处决动作和自适应镜头；杰洛特与萝卜的移动动作、猎魔人感官和界面也有调整。试玩者认为新镜头更能应对战斗场面，但攻击命中敌人的冲击感仍然不足，战斗手感没有发生根本变化。

content.v: 《生化危机》新电影被称创下系列本土票房纪录，但支撑这一说法的数字前后矛盾：文章一处写本土收入为1.96亿美元，另一处又写本土收入为1.03亿美元、海外收入为9300万美元。目前无法据此确认该片是否刷新了系列本土纪录。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790628080_498937_jpg_r.jpg
这部新片由扎克·克雷格执导。原文形容影片获得影评人和部分系列游戏粉丝的积极反响，并称其在上映第二个周末位列票房榜第二。排在首位的是《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》重映版。
票房纪录的疑点集中在同一篇文章的两种表述。文章先称《生化危机》新电影本土票房达到1.96亿美元，已成为系列本土票房最高的电影；随后又将影片收入拆分为本土1.03亿美元和海外9300万美元。后两项相加恰为1.96亿美元，但与前述“本土票房1.96亿美元”的说法不符。
至于全球票房，系列现有纪录由《生化危机：终章》保持，该片全球票房超过3.14亿美元。新电影采取分批海外上映的安排，日本要到10月9日才上映，因此其全球票房仍会继续变化。
影片由奥斯汀·艾布拉姆斯饰演医疗快递员布莱恩。他为照顾怀孕的女友和即将出生的孩子，接下将神秘包裹送往浣熊市实验室的加班任务，途中遭遇丧尸、变异犬等威胁。新版《生化危机》目前已在影院及IMAX上映。

B&H Photo is offering a solid deal on a prebuilt desktop computer that excels at 1080p and 1440p gaming. For a limited time you can pick up a brand new MSI Codex Z2C RTX 5070 gaming PC for just $1,399 with free shipping. The system comes with a download voucher for the upcoming Control: Resonant game, which comes out on September 22. Redemption instructions are found on Nvidia's website .
The MSI Codex Z2C RTX 5070 Gaming PC Drops to $1399

The MSI Codex Z2C gaming PC is equipped with an AMD Ryzen 7 8700F CPU, GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GPU, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB M.2 SSD. The Ryzen 7 8700F is an 8-core, 16-thread processor with a max boost clock of 5.1GHz. It's not the fastest or newest AMD CPU, but it's still a solid gaming CPU that won't bottleneck the GPU, especially at the higher resolutions you should be playing at if you own a 5070 Ti. A 750W PSU powers the system.
The GeForce RTX 5070 GPU is an excellent choice for 1080p or 1440p gaming

The GeForce RTX 5070 is the best Nvidia card for 1080p and 1440p gaming and by itself this card retails for $600 (although generally it's higher these days). It's also powerful enough to run most games at 4K, although at that point you'll see noticeable gains jumping up to a 5070 Ti. Compared to the previous generation GPUs, the RTX 5070 offers a slight performance improvement over the RTX 4070 Super, which was and still is an excellent GPU. The fps gain is greater in games that support DLSS 4.5 with multi-frame generation. Check out our RTX 5070 review .

content.v: 《巫师3：重制版》将于今日(9月29日)推出，成为《巫师》系列未来数年新内容的开端。后续计划还包括2027年的新资料片，以及计划于2028年发售的《巫师4》。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790627724_971581.jpg
重制版将加入技术和画面更新，并调整技能系统、扩展拍照模式、改进战斗，增加装备外观幻化功能。已经拥有原版游戏的玩家可以免费获得重制版。
新资料片《往昔之歌》原计划于2026年推出，现已延期至2027年。资料片将讲述杰洛特“交棒”前的又一段旅程，玩家会前往吟游诗人丹德里恩的故乡莱滕。新主线任务《荆棘之床》中，杰洛特还将遇见莉拉；现有描述暗示，她可能成为杰洛特的感情对象。
小说方面，《巫师》系列作者安杰伊·萨普科夫斯基近日在波兰托伦的Copernicon活动上表示，计划在2027年底前完成下一部杰洛特故事小说。该书何时出版尚不明确，写作计划也可能调整。
CDPR计划于2028年推出《巫师4》。新作将由希里担任主角和可操作角色，杰洛特也会在游戏中登场。
CDPR此前还提出，以《巫师4》发售为起点，在六年内推出新的《巫师》三部曲。如果这一计划按期推进，《巫师5》和《巫师6》将在2034年底前推出；目前不能确定这一时间表能否实现。
系列其他项目中，一款《巫师》多人游戏据称仍在开发，但尚未正式展示。CDPR还与Scopely合作开发一款基于旗下作品的手游，目前尚未确认它属于《巫师》系列，也可能取材于《赛博朋克》系列。

content.v: 若终章《最终幻想7：启示》按计划于明年4月推出，《最终幻想7：重制版》三部曲便有望在约七年内完成。外媒Gamesradar认为，在大型游戏开发周期拉长的当下，这样的开发节奏恐难再现。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790627598_400610_jpg_r.jpg
《最终幻想7：重制版》于2015年亮相，当时PlayStation拥有一批独占游戏，也在大力支持独立游戏；即便如此，重制版的公布仍让作者印象深刻。这部曾以PS3技术演示形式出现的作品，后来扩展为面向PlayStation平台的三部曲。
Gamesradar起初怀疑，原作内容是否足以支撑三部大型游戏。玩过《最终幻想7：重制版》与《最终幻想7：重生》后，其改变了看法，并期待终章如何呈现后续故事。按其估算，若终章如期推出，三部作品合计可提供约200小时的游玩内容。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790627599_849490_jpg_r.jpg
游戏总监滨口直树在终章公布后接受彭博社采访时，将其约三年的开发周期归因于三部曲一直保留核心开发团队，并坚持整体创作方向。作者认为，这种做法也留下了一些显得过时的 开放世界 设计，但扩展后的场景和叙事仍是他看重的部分。

items.title: 这款已有 34 年历史的生存游戏将于 10 月进行“根本性”更新
items.summary: Are you ready to make some socks?

content.v: Survival game UnReal World is getting an update this October: Here's why that's rad:

That last bullet is important. Materials for garments are expensive: one of the screenshots in the patch notes shows a woman, Heta, bartering for nine feet of linen cloth with another characher. She is offering up a hunting bow, 5 arrows, and a handaxe, and the seller still isn't willing to close the deal.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4UEMB55T9sSUG3B7JXuWU4-1920-80.jpg

"Heta is haggling over the price of 9 feet of linen cloth. That's just the length required for making an undershirt," the developer says . "Oh how light, soft and cosy undershirt it would make, but there is really a price to pay for that."

Yeah, this isn't a survival game where you quickly grab some plant fiber or animal skins and sprint to a crafting bench to instantly bang yourself out new set of pantaloons. It's gonna cost a lot and take quite a bit of time to make your clothing.

"I've already become quite fond of having the characters spend their evenings or short winter days crafting a whole new set of things, developing their clothcrafting skills, and enjoying the satisfaction of making good-quality garments for themselves," the dev says.
This is my favorite quote from the patch notes:
"Heta has spent several moonlit evenings making socks for herself. Few more evenings to go, and she can finally try them on."
Several evenings. Just making socks! And after a few more nights of hard work she'll be able to actually put them on. Now that's a survival game.

Here's UnReal World on Steam and the full announcement about " The Survivor's New Clothes" update . One more link: why not check out our 2025 feature about the two developers behind UnReal World , Sam Maaranen and Erkka Lehmus of Enormous Elk.

content.v: 近日CDPR公布了《巫师3：重制版》PC配置需求。若要在4K分辨率下开启路径追踪并达到60帧，需要使用NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080，同时启用DLSS升频和帧生成。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260929/1790627064_599212_jpg_r.jpg
这款游戏推出至今已有约11年。此次公布的较低配置档位要求仍相对宽松。4K路径追踪60帧这一目标则需要显卡与两项画面增强功能共同支持。
详细说明：
若要运行《巫师3：重制版》，PC玩家需配备Intel Core i5-8400或AMD Ryzen 5-2600 处理器、12GB 内存，以及NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660、AMD Radeon RX5500 XT或Intel Arc A580 显卡。在此配置下，游戏可在低画质设置下以1080p/30帧运行。不过GeForce GTX1660也能支持60帧运行。
若要在高画质设置下以1080p/60帧游玩，则需要Intel Core i7-8700K 或AMD Ryzen 5-3600X 处理器、16GB 内存，以及NVIDIA GeForce RTX2060 Super、AMD Radeon RX6600 XT或Intel Arc B580显卡。
若要在极致画质设置下以1440p/60帧游玩，则需要Intel Core i7-13700K或AMD Ryzen 7-7700X 处理器、24GB 内存，以及NVIDIA GeForce RTX3070 Ti、AMD Radeon RX6800 XT或Intel Arc B580 显卡(需开启 XeSS)。
接下来看看光追模式的PC配置需求。若要开启光线追踪，需要Intel Core i7-11700K或AMD Ryzen 7-5800X 处理器、16GB 内存，以及 NVIDIA GeForce RTX2060 Super、AMD Radeon RX6600 XT或Intel Arc B580 显卡。若采用这套PC配置，在1080p分辨率下达到30帧需开启超分辨率技术(upscaler)。
若要在1440p分辨率下开启极高光追设置，你需要配备Intel Core i7-13700K或AMD Ryzen 7-7700X处理器、24GB内存，以及NVIDIA GeForce RTX4080或AMD Radeon RX9070XT显卡。在此配置下，若开启DLSS或FSR，即可达到60帧。
若要在4K分辨率下体验路径追踪效果，则需要Intel Core i9-13900K或AMD Ryzen 7-9800X3D处理器、24GB内存以及NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080显卡。如果同时使用超分辨率技术和帧生成功能，便可达到60帧。

items.title: 动视公司不断宣扬《现代战争 4》的所有正确观点
items.summary: Activision has made a key announcement about how Double XP tokens work in the upcoming Call of Duty: Modern Wa

content.v: Activision has made a key announcement about how Double XP tokens work in the upcoming Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and it sounds like good news.

Beginning with MW4, 2XP tokens will only count down when you're actually in a match. Previously, the timer would tick down when you were in a game's menus or searching for a match. That's not ideal for a lot of reasons, obviously.

If you're anything like me, sometimes you have to get up to let your dog out. Or you want to get up to grab some food or a drink. Or, you might sit in the game's menus when nature calls. Now, you can do those things and still get the full amount of 2XP without your bonus going to waste.

Beyond this, several key developers at Infinity Ward discussed a range of hot topics about MW4 in a newly published "The Road to Launch" video. Check it out below to hear what the team had to say about time-to-kill values, spawning algorithms, and UI issues following the game's multiple rounds of beta testing.

This is just the latest positive-sounding update for MW4, following the previous confirmation that players will be able to toggle off skins they don't want to see in Warzone --though the toggle is not supported for MW4 itself yet.

Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23 for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PC. The game marks the first Call of Duty release on a Nintendo platform since 2013's Call of Duty: Ghosts. It's also the first game since Ghosts to skip PS4 and Xbox One.

items.title: 魔兽世界：Forever 的 Beta 版规模不断扩大
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever's beta is in full swing, and if its popularity is any indication of how the full la

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever's beta is in full swing, and if its popularity is any indication of how the full launch might go, it's going to be big, as Blizzard has had to increase the beta's population cap multiple times.

Forever was Blizzard's big finale during its BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony , a modified version of WoW Classic that keeps the old-school MMORPG's gameplay and world but brings plenty of new changes and content as well. It's something WoW Classic players have asked for years, and Blizzard is now finally ready to deliver.

The beta kicked off September 17 with an initial level cap of 20 and will run through October 21, with Forever's full launch slated for November 4. It's important to note that it's not an open beta that anyone can join. Players need to purchase the $60 Skyborne Epic Pack (which unlocks the new playable Skyborne race in Forever) to gain access .

Despite a $60 barrier to entry, everything points towards the beta being huge. From the get go, the beta ran into problems due to sheer popularity, with WoW: Forever senior game producer Tom Ellis (who has since deleted their X account ) posting a technical breakdown that boiled many of the beta's initial issues down to the game's beta environment simply not being accustomed to such high demand.

It wasn't long before other developers at Blizzard began to chime in on how unprecedented the Forever's beta seemed to be. WoW executive producer Holly Longdale posted that Forever's beta was "setting records." Two days later on September 19, she said "launch will be wild…and we are here for it, come what may."
Most recently, Longdale chimed in about the beta's success once more. On September 27, she wrote Blizzard had to increase the beta's population cap once again. "The wild ride continues," she said .

Longdale hasn't been the only one commenting on how big the beta seems to be. Senior game designer Josh Greenfield, who frequently answers from the game's community on X , said the beta "has been crazy."
"The craziest numbers I've seen in 17 years working at Blizzard and almost 8 years on Classic," Greenfield said. "We've got something really special here."

When asked how Blizzard was preparing to handle potential login queues at launch, Greenfield said the beta itself was the answer, as the team had found and fixed more problems on beta launch day than it would have in six months of internal testing.

Still, given how some previous WoW launches have gone, it certainly wouldn't be surprising if Forever were to run into technical issues at launch, despite the game essentially doing away with traditional servers. Blizzard hasn't yet released exact beta numbers, but off of everything we've seen so far, Forever's launch is shaping up to be a doozy.

For more on WoW: Forever, be sure check out how Blizzard approached designing over 1,000 new quests , why it won't include Season of Discovery's biggest changes , and how big a deal it is that it's launching with full controller support .

items.title: “就我而言，这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步”——《流亡之路》开发者对《暗黑破坏神 5》持乐观态度
items.summary: While Diablo 5 was announced at Blizzcon 2026 just a couple weeks ago, the game doesn't come out until Spring

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/12/diablo-v-1789237822781.png

While Diablo 5 was announced at Blizzcon 2026 just a couple weeks ago, the game doesn't come out until spring 2029. But it seems like Chris Wilson, former co-founder of Path of Exile developer Grinding Gear Games, is tentatively excited for Blizzard's next ARPG.

Wilson, who left Grinding Gear Games in 2023, released a video over the weekend where he broke down everything Blizzard has announced about the upcoming Diablo game, from its story to itemization and monster levels. And while he did have some nitpicks, it seems like he's cautiously optimistic that the Diablo series is headed in the right direction, because of the influence the seminal Diablo 2 seems to have on it so far.

Wilson is particularly fond of the new character and inventory screen, where items once again boast different sizes, along with stats that are more in line with Diablo 2. However, there are some modern choices, such as a flat DPS number on weapons, that rub him the wrong way. Still, he recognizes that Diablo 5 can't fully embrace Diablo 2's at-times clunky design.

"There's a bigger question if they're going to go all the way and risk alienating the modern audience that they've cultivated over the last couple of decades," he said. "I don't think they necessarily should. While selfishly it'd be amazing for them to make a new version of Diablo 2 just for me, I don't think they could justify an investment of that size for a game with a niche audience."

Instead, Wilson expects that Diablo V will try to adopt the best of both worlds, with a "modern ARPG that borrows heavily from Diablo 2, rather than a true return to the design philosophy of Diablo 2."

But even though the game is still a couple years away, according to Blizzard, Wilson thinks Diablo 5 is going to end up delayed. He says, "My best guess is the game won't be ready for spring 2029, but that's okay, delays happen and are normal in this industry. I can't count the amount of times I had to delay a Path of Exile League release and players were okay with it."

If anything, delaying Diablo 5 would give Diablo 4 more room to breathe. Just like a lot of players, Wilson feels like the early announcement of D5 is a sign that Blizzard is abandoing Diablo 4 – even if Blizzard itself has denied that in an interview with PC Gamer . Instead, Blizzard is going to keep developing the story with new seasons, the latest of which is a 30-year celebration of the franchise.

I've already spent almost 50 hours in Season 15 alone, and have been having a blast with all the nostalgic content Blizzard added this time around. Chris Wilson is less amused by it, saying, "To be honest, this event feels pretty distasteful to me," because "Diablo 4 was slowly building up to you being able to fight all the prime evils, then they introduce them all at once in a special event that isn't really tied to the games story."

Regardless, new seasons will continue to filter out to Diablo 4 over the next year and a half. Blizzard will also be adding Diablo 2's Amazon class to the game in a DLC pack early next year. Speaking of classes, the company has also revealed a handful of the classes coming to Diablo 5 , and that at launch the new game will apparently have more classes available than in any previous Diablo game. I'm just hoping they bring back the Demon Hunter from Diablo 3 .

items.title: 索尼有史以来第一次跳过 CES，这是 PlayStation 最愚蠢的公告之一
items.summary: Sony has attended every edition of the Consumer Electronics Show (CES) since it debuted in 1967 , but that's e

content.v: Sony has attended every edition of the Consumer Electronics Show (CES) since it debuted in 1967 , but that's ending for the upcoming show in January 2027. This means there won't be any PlayStation news, at least not directly from Sony.

The company confirmed to Bloomberg that it's pulling out of the show this year following a strategic evaluation of its approach to "events and communications based on the needs and priorities of our diverse business."
The company went on to say that today it's putting more focus on "entertainment," including games, anime, films, and music. CES, on the other hand, is primarily a technology show.
What PlayStation announcements have there been at CES before?

Sony's showing at CES historically includes a keynote address, featuring executives and creative leaders from the company discussing upcoming technologies and products. Sony never made the most momentous PlayStation announcements at its CES events over the years, but it was an event that fans could expect some news, at least.

For example, in 2020, then-PlayStation boss Jim Ryan revealed the PS5 logo at CES . At the time, people were clamoring for any morsel of news about the console, and fans roasted Sony for revealing only the logo. You can re-live the moment where everyone learned that the logo would be the most predictable logo ever in the video below. The juicier details like the release date, price, and technical specifics were saved for later events dedicated to the system.

At CES 2022, Sony unveiled PlayStation VR2 and a new game for it, Horizon: Call of the Mountain. In more recent years, Sony's PlayStation-related announcements at CES pertained to the company's transmedia adaptations, including the announcement of Horizon and Helldivers movies .

Microsoft, for its part, revealed the original Xbox with Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson at CES 2001, but the company didn't carry the tradition forward with similarly big Xbox announcements at CES over the years. Nintendo, meanwhile, famously revealed the first version of the NES at CES in 1984--it was unveiled as a prototype known as the Advanced Video System .
CES 2027 takes place January 6-9 in Las Vegas.

items.title: 星际：特洛伊·贝克说，异端先知正在“测试顽皮狗能力的界限”
items.summary: Troy Baker has teased that Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet is "testing the bounds" of what Naughty Dog is c

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/28/intergalactic-the-heretic-prophet-1790624421706.png
Troy Baker has teased that Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet is "testing the bounds" of what Naughty Dog is capable of, telling fans that they are going to have their "minds blown."

The Last of Us actor, who is also featured in the studio's new sci-fi adventure , talked about what the studio is cooking up during an appearance at Ottawa Comiccon in Ontario, Canada, earlier this month. Footage of his panel was captured and shared on YouTube before clips made their way around social media today, but the biggest highlight from the hour-long talk saw Baker teasing Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet.
"You guys are going to have your minds blown," he said. Covering his mouth and closing his eyes, he added, "You are not ready. You are not ready. It's so good."

Baker noted that, as previously announced, Naughty Dog recently wrapped shooting performance capture for the studio's new IP . Of all of the things to call attention to, though, it's star Tati Gabrielle and her work as main character, Jordan A. Mun.

"I don't know how [writer and director Neil Druckmann] found two amazing actors," he added, referencing Ashley's Johnson's casting as Ellie in The Last of Us. "He found Ashley for Ellie, and he found Tati for Jordan. It's like, what? How do you do that?

"She is the spiritual successor. There is so much about Jordan and that game of Intergalactic that feels like… man, I feel all of it. I feel Uncharted, I feel The Last of Us, I feel something new. They are testing the bounds of what that studio is capable of. Everything that I've seen, they are delivering, and it's going to be incredible."

We know precious little about Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet since Naughty Dog first revealed it at The Game Awards 2024. Druckmann called the new game " incredible " in 2025, and later that same year, he joked that he's been "bootcamp-ing" Gabrielle on the hate the studio's received regarding The Last of Us Part 2 . He also said he was stepping away from HBO's The Last of Us show to pour his focus into the project's development .

Despite calling it the "most ambitious game" the team has made to date , the only actual look at it we've seen arrived in that first reveal trailer. Despite there being no firm release date, as Naughty Dog no-shows State of Plays and goes on seven years without a new game release , there are at least a few reasons to suspect we'll learn more in the somewhat near future.

We knew Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet would miss 2026, but there have been rumors that the PlayStation developer is shooting for a 2027 launch. Wrapping up work on performance capture just last month means that progress is moving steadily ahead, too. The Last of Us Part 2 reached a similar milestone one year before its 2020 launch in 2019, so if the team is following that same trajectory, there is at least hope we'll learn more in the months ahead.

Unfortunately, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet has no official launch schedule in place for now. In the meantime, The Last of Us Day 2026 has given fans a little something to chew on while they await the series' return. The series' future is something Baker touched on during his convention appearance, too.
"We'll see," he said, crossing his fingers.

items.title: Steam 的整理游戏趋势即将获得它所缺失的鬼魂肉
items.summary: Something is Wrong with the Library is bringing some much-needed texture to organizing sims.

content.v: What happened:
It's nice to see some aura in the tidying space

In recent months, Steam has been awash in organize-em-ups and haystack searchers —games capitalizing on the simple pleasure of arranging a chaotic melange into an orderly assemblage. But while I'd never think to deny the meditative appeal of putting a thing in a place, I'm not going to pretend that the emergent craze isn't undergoing the same gold rush of low-effort iteration that we saw during the rash of retail sims. Visit the page for the "Organizing" tag , and you'll find as many generic variations on "Tidy up the [X]" with AI logos as the Unity and Unreal asset stores can sustain.

With Strange Scaffold at the helm, however, I feel safe betting that Something is Wrong with the Library's haunted meat labyrinth will be able to offer a sense of identity and direction that's been hard to find among the available tidying sims. After all, this is a developer that was able to use clicking as a medium for a harrowing test of psychosexual fortitude . And then made a match-three metroidvania-slash-survival-sim-parody set in a weirdo dinosaur mansion. And then an isekai-enabling driving sim .
If nothing else, we can trust the studio to commit to the bit. It seems incapable—possibly pathologically—of doing otherwise.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/28/witcher3-crop-1790622505249.jpg

Milan Records has released a five-track EP of new original music from The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt's upcoming Songs of the Past expansion. Titled The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Songs of the Past (Original Soundtrack Gamescom 2026 EP), the first taste of the DLC's soundtrack includes compositions from Magda Urbanska, Marcin Pryzbylowicz, and Daniel Elms.

"I’ve worked with classical music for most of my life," Urbanska said. "But folk requires a completely different sensibility — it has its own tone and form, while also offering enormous creative freedom. But our roots, our Slavic heritage, are something more than that — something that runs deep within us, something that grows out of who we are. I hope we’ve managed to preserve The Witcher DNA in these pieces."

Publisher Milan Records describes the new music as such: "Created to accompany Geralt of Rivia's return to the Path, the soundtrack expands upon the rich musical identity that has made The Witcher franchise a global phenomenon. Blending evocative orchestral writing with traditional folk influences, powerful vocal performances, and regional instrumentation inspired by the world's diverse cultures, the score captures both the intimacy and grandeur of a new chapter in Geralt's story." Here's the tracklist of the EP, which you can hear now everywhere :

Songs of the Past was a nearly unprecedented announcement earlier this year (though it had been rumored ): a new expansion for a game that will be 12 years old by the time Songs of the Past ships next year, and the first expansion in over a decade. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was named IGN's Game of the Year in 2015 .

items.title: 暗黑破坏神 4 第 15 季充满了大秘密，而且它们还在不断涌现
items.summary: Diablo 4 Season 15 is stuffed full of secrets years in the making, and despite the season having launched two

content.v: Diablo 4 Season 15 is stuffed full of secrets years in the making, and despite the season having launched two weeks ago, players keep discovering new ones.

Season 15, Hell's Legacy, is a major nostalgia trip for Diablo fans. It adds new dungeons, boss fights, and items from previous Diablo games to Diablo 4, as players team up with Deckard Cain to defeat echoes of the Prime Evils and harness some of their iconic powers.

But those references to previous games go far beyond a handful of dungeons and bosses. It also added a full Horadric Cube's worth of secrets. Some stem from older games in the franchise, while others are a continuation of ones added in Diablo 4 that players have worked towards uncovering for years.

After years of searching, Blizzard finally gave players the culmination of its secret cow-level hunt, as players who have gone through the laborious task of reaching the cow level and battling the cow king can now go even one step further to take on Moophisto , the Divine Bovine. In that same vein, players can also finally catch Mefishto , a secret fishing boss Blizzard went as far as to tease with a bizarre infomercial back when the game's Lord of Hatred expansion launched. Players were also quick to discover all kinds of new runewords and items from previous Diablo games, like the highly coveted Enigma that converts each class' evade into a teleport.

But those are just some of the secrets. Players can also visit Old Tristram (complete with Diablo 1 NPCs like Griswold, Wirt and Adria) by finding all of Deckard Cain's journals, and even take on an Uber Prime Evil boss encounter there like in Diablo 2. For those who like their secrets silly, Diablo 3's Whimsyshire is now in the game after being teased as part of the cow-level quest, complete with hundreds of colorful killer teddy bears and unicorns.

One of the coolest secrets in the seasons is the next phase of the Lucky Coin questline that players have been scratching their heads about since Diablo 4's launch. In Season 15, the last of these lucky coins can now be found. By converting each coin into a special jewelry item, equipping them, and going to Lorath's old house, a portal opens to an all-new Echo of the Horadrim boss fight , where players take on the tormented souls of Lorath, Neyrelle, and Donan.

That might seem like a fitting end to the season's secrets, but nearly all of these secrets lead to even more puzzles for the community to solve. There still seem to be some secrets involving the cow level, as one piece of the cow-themed Bovine armor set is still missing. Players have fished up a teddy bear head that appears to be a reference to a quest from Diablo's Hellfire expansion and may be linked to Whimsyshire.

The Horadrim boss encounter rewards players with a Horadric Coin, the purpose of which is still a mystery. Players have discovered a secret sheep level as part of the cow level, one that rewards an item called Map of the Stars that looks to be a reference to a deleted quest in Diablo 1. The quest item's description even states, "Oh for hell's sake, what now!?," seeming to imply there's still plenty more mysteries to keep Diablo 4 secret hunters busy.

Diablo lore expert Loatheburger has a great breakdown of the season's remaining secrets, including one that may involve salvaging a certain number of Stone of Jordan rings in order to summon a special Diablo boss fight.

After a disappointing Season 14 , Hell's Legacy looks to have put Blizzard's ARPG back on the right footing with its crowd-pleasing theme and a giant heaping of content ripped from older Diablo games, even as players are becoming stronger than ever with a Mythic Unique trick that might not be intentional .

Though Diablo 4 won't receive new expansions as the focus shifts to the development of Diablo 5 , due to release in 2029, it will continue to receive new seasons long into the future, Blizzard has said. The Amazon will be added as a standalone class DLC in the first half of next year.

items.summary: The main voice actor cast for upcoming soulslike Valor Mortis has been revealed, and its star-studded lineup f

content.v: The main voice actor cast for upcoming soulslike Valor Mortis has been revealed, and its star-studded lineup features the surprising addition of a name better known for fronting a black metal band.
Adam "Nergal" Darski will play the role of Captain Raphael. If his impressive growls and screams in Behemoth are anything to go by, players can expect a pretty dramatic rendition of the character.
It's not his first rodeo, surprisingly. He also voiced The Black Cat in 2022's Blacktail and was the narrator for Apocalipsis: The Tree of the Knowledge of Good and Evil in 2018.

He's joining an impressive roster of voice actors, including Baldur's Gate 3 and Expedition 33's Jennifer English as The Shrike and Onimusha: Way of the Sword and Crimson Desert's James Alexander as William Dowsett. Napoleon Bonaparte will be played by Vincent Cassel, who has starred in the Ocean's Twelve and Ocean's Thirteen films as François Toulour.

Mars Lipowski, who is best known for portraying Sobieslaw "Gromsko" Kosciuszko in the Call of Duty franchise, will take on the role of Lucjan Skawinski. Will De Renzy-Martin, who played Coen in The Blood of Dawnwalker, will portray James Stewart. Finally, Yvan Chamouiseau will step into the shoes of Louis Moreau.

Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the developer of Ghostrunner. Set in an alternate 19th century Eastern Europe, Napoleon's endless war has led to a supernatural plague. You'll follow William, played by Alexander, as he fights to survive against his former comrades who are now undead monsters.

Valor Mortis is set for release on Xbox Series X|S, PS5, and PC on October 13, and will be priced at $40 because this fall has a jam-packed release schedule, the developer admitted recently. It was originally scheduled for launch on September 24, but due to how busy September was , it was delayed by a few weeks.

content.v: If you're a fan of The Witcher franchise, you're getting a lot of new stuff over the next few years, starting this week with the launch of The Witcher 3 Remastered.
Here's what's on tap for The Witcher over the next few years:

The Witcher 3 Remastered, which includes a bevy of technical and graphical updates and improvements, releases on September 29. The long-awaited remaster, which is free for people who already own the game, includes a reimagined skill system, an expanded photo mode, improved combat, and a new transmog feature. Check out GameSpot's in-depth breakdown of what's new in the remaster to find out more. Just be aware, the graphical overhaul isn't necessarily an entirely positive one .

After that will come a new expansion for The Witcher 3, Songs of the Past, in 2027. The expansion was originally targeting a 2026 release, but it was pushed to 2027 to make it as good and polished as possible.

Songs of the Past takes Geralt on one last ride “before passing the torch.” Players will venture to the location of Letten, home of Geralt's friendly bard companion, Dandelion. There is a new main quest called "A Bed of Thorns" where Geralt will meet up with Lilla, who appears to be a potential love interest for Geralt.
Also in 2027? That's when The Witcher author Andrzej Sapkowski said he plans to finish the next entry in the novel series, telling the next Geralt of Rivia story.

At the Copernicon event in Torun, Poland recently, Wiedzminlandia reported (via Redanian Intelligence ) that Sapkowski said he plans to finish the book by the end of 2027, but it's unclear how soon after that it may actually release. Sapkowski's plans could change, but in any event, a new book is coming, and fans of The Witcher may be excited about that.

Then in 2028, CD Projekt Red plans to release The Witcher 4. The game doesn't star Geralt, but instead focuses on Ciri and makes her the playable character. Geralt is set to appear in the game, however.

Given The Witcher 4 is coming out in 2028, it likely won't be a on a disc for console due to Sony's decision to end support for physical media. There will be some kind of physical version of the game , however.
2029 and beyond

CD Projekt Red previously outlined an ambitious plan to release a new trilogy of The Witcher games within a six-year window that begins with The Witcher 4's launch in 2028. If that schedule holds, fans can expect The Witcher 5 and The Witcher 6 to launch by the end of 2034. That's a lot of Witcher games in a relatively short amount of time. CD Projekt Red is known to delay most of its big games, so there is definitely no guarantee that the plan will hold.
Other Witcher projects

Beyond all of these projects from The Witcher franchise, CD Projekt Red is believed to be working on a multiplayer Witcher game. The game has undergone numerous changes over the years , and the developer has never shown it off.
Additionally, CD Projekt is working with Scopely on a new mobile game based on one of its franchises . It's not confirmed that it's The Witcher, however; another candidate could be Cyberpunk.

items.title: 看哪，价值 60 美元的《战争机器》披萨刀，清洁起来真的很痛苦
items.summary: Xbox has announced its next collaboration, and it's a partnership with Prince St. Pizza for a specially brande

content.v: Xbox has announced its next collaboration, and it's a partnership with Prince St. Pizza for a specially branded Gears of War pizza and a $60 pizza-cutter.

Microsoft and Prince St. Pizza teamed up to make a Prototype Lancer pizza-cutter to promote this October's Gears of War: E-Day, and it's available for $60 . To justify the steep price tag, Prince St. Pizza says it's a hefty metal cutter featuring a stainless steel blade and a handle that's meant to make you feel like you're wielding the iconic gun. The pizza-cutter also comes with the in-game pizza emblem. It does look pretty great, but it also looks like a real pain the butt to clean if you're a messy person like me.

If anyone is wondering why it's called the Prototype Lancer and not just the Lancer, that's the special solution the developers came up with to explain why the heck a Lancer would even be in a prequel like E-Day . In the Gears of War lore, the weapon was created a year after the events of Emergence Day. However, you can't have a Gears game without the Lancer, so the developers called it a Prototype Lancer.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/EPizza_a038a3.jpg?w=636

As for the pizza itself, it's called the Emergence Pie, and it's themed around this October's Gears of War: E-Day, which is a prequel that tells the story of Emergence Day. The pizza includes spicy vodka red sauce and mozzarella cheese, along with proteins in the form of pepperoni and sausage. The pizza is also doused with spicy Italian chili crisp.

"Rugged, relentless, and built to hit hard, it’s the kind of pie that doesn’t go quietly," reads a line from Microsoft's blog post. It's also a pizza that doesn't go quietly for your wallet, as it costs a mighty $46 before taxes or delivery fees if you're getting it sent to your home.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/GearsofPizza_91db61.jpg?w=636

The Emergence Pie is available now through November 1 at Prince St. Pizza locations in the US and Canada. Prince St. Pizza is not exactly a household name, and there are only about 20 locations in the world in places like Chicago, Los Angeles, Dallas, Las Vegas, Miami, Nashville, and New York City. The single location in Canada can be found in Toronto.
Anyone who buys the Emergence Pie also gets a code to unlock a pizza emblem in E-Day.
Gears of War: E-Day releases on October 6 for PC and Xbox Series X|S, and it's available at launch via Xbox Game Pass. People can buy the $100 premium edition to play five days early.

Despite obvious evidence that Microsoft was planning to release E-Day on PS5, the company denied that it made a last-minute decision to cancel a PS5 version. The company did not deny the existence of a PS5 version, however. E-Day is not a timed-exclusive for Xbox , Microsoft's Aaron Greenberg has said, leading some to believe it will never come to PS5. However, Greenberg said in 2021 that Starfield was not a timed exclusive on Xbox … and then it came to PS5.

items.summary: Naughty Dog has revealed it's celebrating The Last of Us Day 2026 with Ghost of Yotei content, player avatars

content.v: https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2020/05/06/the-last-of-us-2---gold-screens-1-1588807678841.jpg

Naughty Dog has revealed that it's celebrating The Last of Us Day 2026 with Ghost of Yotei content, player avatars on PlayStation and Steam, and an hour-long ambience video as fans continue begging for any updates on The Last of Us Part 3.

It's… probably not what you or anyone else was expecting to see when the Sony studio teased plans for its annual holiday over the weekend . Instead of confirmation for The Last of Us Part 3 (or even yet, another remaster of an existing title), Naughty Dog instead revealed a collection of smaller surprises to keep fans tied over.

The headline is no doubt an armor set that's coming to Sucker Punch Productions' Ghost of Yotei. Available starting October 1, players will be able to hop into the sequel's Most Wanted mode while sporting Clicker-inspired armor. After it's unlocked, players will be able to use it in the base game, as well as its new Echoes of Sekigahara DLC. You can see a first look at The Last of Us armor below.

So, what else is there for The Last of Us Day 2026? Naughty Dog also announced a partnership with collectible company Youtooz for a Bloody Clicker figure. In addition to the previously revealed Welcome Hub background wallpaper for PS5, PlayStation users can enjoy four new themed avatars, with even more available on PC via Steam.

Also starting October 1 at 10 AM PDT / 1 PM EDT is a new Steam and Epic Games Store sale, which will discount The Last of Us Part 1 by 50% and The Last of Us Part 2 by 33%. There's also a new hour-long subway ambiance video for those who miss living in the series' Cordyceps-infested world. Does any of this come with a tease for The Last of Us Part 3? Well, no. Not at all.

It's been more than six years since Naughty Dog released The Last of Us Part 2, the series' latest entry. While the time between has seen the launch of important installments in the groundbreaking post-apocalyptic franchise, including the launch of two seasons for its live-action HBO adaptation , it's also brought disappointment for fans.

Perhaps the biggest blow to those hoping to hear more about where the franchise is heading was the cancellation of the long-in-development multiplayer spinoff , which many referred to as The Last of Us Online . Sony officially pulled the plug in December 2023, with Naughty Dog team promising it would focus solely on single-player games going forward.

As The Last of Us Part 3 remains absent and without any official confirmation that it's even in development, the studio is still very much in the weeds of its next new IP, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet . Initial footage for the project seemed promising when it was shown off in 2024 , but two years later, we still know little about it, too.

In addition to all of today's aforementioned goodies and a No Return charity stream for AbleGamers, the studio also announced it has established dedicated The Last of Us social media pages across Instagram , Facebook , and X/Twitter . Still, fans spent the days leading up to The Last of Us Day hoping the holiday would come with any news about the future of the series. Some hoped it might come with confirmation that The Last of Us Part 3 was in the works at all, but for now, at least, it seems fans will have to wait.

The future of The Last of Us continues to be a mystery as Naughty Dog celebrates The Last of Us Day 2026. In the meantime, you can see why some fans think a tease from Neil Druckmann suggests a third game will happen eventually . You can also read up on the multiplayer mod canceled at Sony's request earlier this month, and the new cast members that joined the show's third season .

items.title: 我安装了太多 mods，导致游戏现在只能在窗口模式下启动，从而破坏了 GTA 5
items.summary: Which I'm taking as a… win?

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .
Can a game go on life support? Can it begin, in its dotage, to show signs of the ailment that everyone knows—but would never say—is the thing that will one day bring it down for good?

Grand Theft Auto 5 can. Installing my latest mod, Dynamic Traffic Colours , has brought my installation of the game to the point that it's failing death rolls. It will only launch in windowed mode, now. Trying to fullscreen the game before it has loaded will leave you suspended in the void. Quite literally: you will reside in an eternal black screen from which escape is impossible, unless you hold CTRL+ALT+DEL.

Anyway, once I was in and windowed, I encountered a mystery. The point of Dynamic Traffic Colours is to mix up the hues of Los Santos' cars. I think it is doing that, but with a conservatism that borders on timidity.

For the most part, the cars I see (and, to be fair, many of them more-or-less implode on spawn) are the same humdrum colours you get all the time. But then, like a vision, you get a car that's a garish mix of tints, sailing past you and into the side of a building.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/aniBuCZgr9HGVvdEqCkuUd-1920-80.jpg

So I don't really know what's going on there. Perhaps it's a lesson to change my thinking. Rather than letting me gorge myself on clown cars, the mod presents them like rare, nourishing treats: oases in the windowed desert. I'm thankful for that.

items.title: 为什么大家突然都在谈论《黑色洛城 2》？
items.summary: Rumors of an LA Noire 2 have been floating around, but is there actually any truth to them?

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/07/07/la-noire-cover-art-1783462785433.jpg
Rumors of an LA Noire 2 have been floating around the internet lately, but is there actually any truth to them?

Over the weekend, eagle-eyed fans dug up an old GTA 6 leak from 2023 . The leak originated on 4Chan and revealed a bunch of details that have actually since been confirmed. Perhaps one of the most notable bits is that Rockstar once planned to have four protagonists in GTA 6 , but eventually settled on two, which was recently confirmed by Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson. However, it is worth noting that this tidbit was also buried in a report from Axios a year prior to the 4Chan leak, as well.

The post went on to reveal details about the game's relationship mechanic, which has also since been confirmed, and teased some spoilers that have been loosely corroborated in other legitimate leaks in recent years. However, the reason people are digging this post back up is because it claims that Rockstar's next game is a sequel to LA Noire, set to release in 2030.

The game would be set in San Francisco and center around the Zodiac Killer, who terrorized the city in the '70s. If there ever were to be an LA Noire followup, this would be the most ideal story to tackle, given that it's rich with unique crimes, people, and has a great setting. So... is any of this real? Let's look at all of the evidence.

For starters, LA Noire was developed by the studio Team Bondi, led by a man named Brendan McNamara. Rockstar published the crime game and lent some developers to assist on the project. Unfortunately, Team Bondi dissolved shortly after LA Noire's release. Not long after, McNamara founded a new studio to make a successor known as The Whore of the Orient ( which we reported new details on earlier this summer ) without the help of Rockstar.

The game was scrapped due to funding issues and McNamara founded yet another studio known as Video Games Deluxe, which helped port LA Noire to VR devices. The studio was acquired by Rockstar in 2025 and renamed to Rockstar Australia, leading many to wonder what they're up to, exactly.

Presumably, they're helping with GTA 6, but a lot of the studio is comprised of ex-LA Noire creatives, including McNamara, who is a renowned storyteller. It seems hard to imagine that a creative like him would be relegated to leading a support studio, so it seems feasible that there could be plans for more games with him at the helm.

Rockstar has also shown an interest in the IP multiple times over the years. LA Noire was the second Rockstar game behind GTA 5 to be ported over to Xbox One and PS4, which raised eyebrows, given fans were more interested in titles like Bully, Red Dead Redemption, or even GTA 4. A condensed version of the game was also ported to VR around the same time, which was an unusual level of investment for Rockstar.

More recently, Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick was asked about the possibility of LA Noire returning . He noted that the door is open for Rockstar to revisit the game, so long as there's a team that's passionate about it.

“Broadly, we’re looking at doing something in the future with all of our intellectual property,” he said in April 2026. “There’s nothing to announce on LA Noire specifically, and if there were, it would be Rockstar announcing it, not me. But in any case, with regard to our legacy IP, the teams are always looking at what we have and we’re always thinking about it. The question is, at any given time, do we have a team that’s passionate about working on that?”

Whether McNamara is invested in another period crime drama remains to be seen, but his team would likely be the ones most gung-ho about going back to LA Noire. In 2012, Rockstar also teased that an LA Noire sequel wasn't off the table, as it was pleased with how the game performed, and Take-Two even noted its importance as a "franchise" moving forward.

"Don't count out the possibility of a new game in the LA Noire franchise in the future," said Rockstar during a fan Q&A. "We simply have not decided anything. We're all very pleased with how that game turned out and are considering what the future may hold for LA Noire as a series. We don't always rush to make sequels, but that does not mean we won't get to them eventually – see Max [Payne] and Red Dead for evidence of that – we have so many games we want to make and the issue is always one of bandwidth and timing."

Either way, it's an exciting prospect to consider, but there are a lot of questions over what direction Rockstar will take post-GTA 6. The game is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch in history, and the studio will likely support the hell out of it with updates over time, especially when its online mode launches in the future .

Will that be all-consuming, eliminating any chance of "smaller" games like an LA Noire sequel, or will the financial success afford Rockstar the opportunity to make more interesting artistic plays? We'll just have to wait and see, but Rockstar is already set to publish a pair of Max Payne remakes , developed by Remedy, so there are opportunities outside of heavily monetized online games.

items.title: The writer of The Witcher 3's best quest has returned to CD Projekt after a decade away
items.summary: After stops at Techland and GSC Game World, Karolina Stachyra is back to where it all began.

content.v: That the quest 'Family Matters' stands out as the best quest in The Witcher 3 —a game filled with great storytelling and characters—is a true testament to the skill of its creators. That's why it's so exciting that one of the main forces behind it, writer Karolina Stachyra, has returned to CD Projekt after a decade away.

Stachyra's LinkedIn profile indicates that she's been working with the studio as a freelance consultant since February, and returned as a full-time writer in August. The quiet comeback went unnoticed until the weekend, though, when b0ysbrokenheart posted about it on X .
And here's the good stuff:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PTBWJYWDHcocBj8PejBuQh-1920-80.png
CD Projekt confirmed that Stachyra is indeed back in the fold, but declined to comment on what she's currently working on.
WHY ARE PEOPLE EXCITED?

We laid it out in 2015: What appears to be a simple missing persons job for Geralt slowly, painfully unwinds into "The Witcher 3’s most emotional and disturbing quest," driven by the conflicted, compelling, and deeply tragic character of the Bloody Baron. As we put it back when all this was new:

"It takes very real, important subjects—alcoholism and domestic abuse—and deals with them in a brutal, heartbreaking, and honest way. But, thanks to the blood-curdling botchling, it still feels like part of The Witcher’s dark fantasy world. It’s superbly written, brilliantly acted, and the branching paths make it well worth replaying. It’s The Witcher 3 and developer CD Projekt RED at their absolute best, and was the highlight of the game for many players."

As the writer of the dialog and cutscenes in Family Matters, not to mention her work elsewhere in the game and on the Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions, Stachyra's return to CD Projekt—following turns as narrative director at Techland and GSC Game World—is great news for RPG fans, regardless of what game she's working on.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4E4Dc9gjBAvDfoSCduaYkR-1920-80.jpg

And since we're left to speculate on that, consider this: Ciri, the lead of the upcoming The Witcher 4 , was a central character in the Family Matters quest and key to demonstrating the depth and nuance of the Bloody Baron, who treated her like a surrogate daughter. Might an adoptive family reunion be in the works? It's not the worst idea I've ever heard.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UiHQzGbgDWuTSBXL62v4Fd-1920-80.jpg

items.title: 《巫师 3》在禁用帧生成的 RTX 5080 上获得 30 FPS
items.summary: The Witcher 3 Remastered comes out tomorrow with a whole host of improvements that yet again bring it into the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/25/witcher3-firstminsoo-1790354351574.png

The Witcher 3 Remastered comes out tomorrow with a whole host of improvements that yet again bring it into the current generation. But it seems like if you want to max the game out with path tracing, you're going to need an absolute beast of a gaming PC.

CD Projekt Red updated The Witcher 3 system requirements ahead of tomorrow's update, and while it is still reasonable on the low end, if you want to enable path tracing at 4K, you're going to need an Nvidia GeForce RTX 5080 , which is going for about $1,650 on the low end right now. Even with that beefy graphics card, the system requirements suggest that you'll need both DLSS upscaling and frame generation to hit 60 fps, which means Nvidia's penultimate GPU still struggles with the 11-year-old game.

So, I of course plugged in an RTX 5080 to see how the game runs with path tracing in a lap around Novigrad, and it isn't great. At 4K with everything enabled, including path tracing and hairworks, with DLSS upscaling set to 'Performance,' the Nvidia 5080 gets an average of 30 fps. That goes up to 59 fps with frame generation, but at that low of a base frame rate, there are some very noticeable artifacts, particularly in the ground textures.

To be fair, hairworks has been nuking frame rates in The Witcher 3 since it first launched back in the day. You can (and probably should) disable hairworks to get much better performance, but even then, the 5080 can't hit 60 fps without frame gen. With hairworks disabled and path tracing enabled at 4K with DLSS set to performance, the game manages a 44 fps average, which jumps to 80 fps when frame generation is enabled.

The best way to get good performance out of The Witcher 3 Remastered right now, short of buying an RTX 5090 , is to disable path tracing entirely. When you do that on the RTX 5080, the frame rate jumps to 55 fps, which is more reasonable, especially considering that all of this testing was done in Novigrad, which has been notorious for performance issues since 2015. Keep in mind that even with path tracing disabled, there are a ton of other ray tracing effects that you can disable to further improve your performance.

Luckily, the new system requirements suggest that the game will scale down well to lower hardware. It'll just be a question of which settings you are willing to disable to get good performance from this massive game. Still, it does sting to play an 11-year-old game with one of the most expensive graphics cards on the market and not be able to max everything out at a good frame rate.

We've got plenty more on The Witcher 3 Remastered, including a roundup of all the improvements , and the global release times . The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered is available as a free update on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2 from September 29. To ease you into Geralt’s life on the road, check out the things The Witcher 3 doesn’t tell you , plus IGN’s The Witcher 3 walkthrough and The Witcher 3 endings guide, which outlines all of the major quests and choices in the base game and expansions (now bundled in with the Remastered edition). When you’re ready for the tough choices, check out our The Witcher 3 sex and romance guide to see who Geralt can smooch and all the opportunities to do so. And to make Geralt as strong a monster hunter as possible, check out all the Witcher gear locations , Places of Power locations , and even Gwent card locations .

items.title: Embark should've implemented a PvE mode into Arc Raiders a long time ago
items.summary: God forbid a raider wants to have a chill time.

content.v: I am very excited at the prospect of an Arc Raiders PvE-only mode. I have been ever since I got a tiny taste of what it could be like in Shared Watch , and even before that while playing in friendly lobbies. I know some aren't happy at the prospect of a mode with no PvP, but the only thing I can't believe is that Embark hasn't made this change sooner.

I've always thought that Arc Raiders was at its best in its early stages when players had to work together to take down high-value arcs. This kind of cooperation led to some genuinely hilarious scenarios or just nice encounters with strangers; something I hadn't experienced in an online multiplayer game for quite some time.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sGejTNdyiUoyifskRyfkGU-1920-80.png

At one point I remember being huddled in a bunker with another trio while trying to take down a Rocketeer on Spaceport. While we did manage to kill it, we were then caught out when a second Rocketeer turned up and we had almost no ammo left. It was a slightly bizarre situation to be found in with strangers. But it led to some very impressive strategy and coordination, and certainly a memorable experience, as we broke off into duos and ran in opposite directions, taking it in turns to distract the Rocketeer so we could all make a successful break for the extraction point.

I think this novelty is what brought a lot of players into Arc Raiders; it's certainly what kept me around for so long even after I'd completed expeditions and all the quests. But as more people left the number of fun encounters dropped and soon most of my interactions in Arc Raiders were just with liars, assholes, or cheaters. And that's not a great way to spend your free time.

If there had been a PvE mode this is when I would've transferred over to that. I probably would have even played Arc Raiders relatively frequently in said mode from there on, as I'm sure others who enjoy the simplicity of fun social interactions and taking down arcs would have as well. But with no other option than increasingly sour PvP lobbies I decided to retire my raider for the time being.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nbcyTKP3ArxM2bmu682tgg-1920-80.jpg

That's not to say PvP is absolutely no fun. Again, early on I had an absolute blast playing in trio PvP lobbies. The tension and strategic play was fantastic and felt really unique to Arc Raiders' ecosystem. Having to be cautious of both arcs and fellow players made games more hectic but that meant there was a better payoff when you all managed to extract in one piece with some hefty loot.
The weird and funny social moments that Arc Raiders did so well isn't exclusive to PvE or PvP lobbies.

It could also lead to equally hilarious scenarios. I still remember when my trio spotted another team from a mile off in Dam Battlegrounds who were clearly trying to flank us and just acting really suspicious. The only problem was they had absolutely no cover but also didn't seem to realise that if they could see us it meant we could also see them. Their surprise attack was quickly felled and then we had to explain to them how line of sight worked as we guided them to extract so they could go home to Speranza.

The weird and funny social moments that Arc Raiders did so well isn't exclusive to PvE or PvP lobbies. But PvE offers a guarantee that PvP can't: your games won't get ruined by assholes who lie or extract camp. And with no sign of the huge anticheat overhaul PvP would need to get fixed I can't see things changing anytime soon, so with that in mind I'd prefer something rather than nothing, because the world of Arc Raiders is simply too cool to watch waste away.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4YvVgs6EMMfr6C7w3YtVSG-1920-80.jpg

Embark has even admitted that a large chunk of Arc Raiders playerbase is PvE orientated , so I'd hardly be surprised if fair chunk of players came back just out of curiosity about what PvE lobbies could look like.

Unfortunately, there's no guarantee that this PvE test will even lead to a permanent addition. But I'll still be checking in to get a taste of what it could be like because a low-intensity Arc Raiders interlude sounds like great fun right about now.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/TCou4LpWxSUzfBu3QPeR6P-1920-80.jpg
